correctness.rationale: For N=2p,p>=2 and q-th roots window with time shifts {0,1} and even frequency modulations, the frame operator splits exactly into p two-dimensional Fourier fibers. With c_r=x_r-x_(r+p), the fiber spectrum is 1±|cos(pi k_r/q)| where k_0=c_0+c_(p-1) and k_r=c_r-c_(r-1). This integer transformation has determinant two: mod odd q its image is all (Z/q)^p, mod even q exactly the even-sum parity code, each with kernel size two. Thus for any threshold a, the exact survival count is h(a)^p for q odd or h(a)^p+d(a)^p for q even, divided by q^p, where h counts allowed fiber residues and d is even minus odd allowed counts. The basis probability, optimal lower bound and exact numbers of optimizers follow by optimizing min distance of k_r from {0,q}, with the q mod 4, p parity branches. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all ratio vectors q=2..7,p=2..5 (bounded total <=200000), 16 survival-threshold comparisons and four full complex Gabor matrix eigenvalue checks verify the formulas, without extrapolating finite evidence to arbitrary p,q.
